ai_eval_band_chk.name: ai_eval_band_chk
ai_eval_band_chk.value: "ai_evaluations"."overall_band" IS NULL OR ("ai_evaluations"."overall_band" >= 0 AND "ai_evaluations"."overall_band" <= 9 AND ("ai_evaluations"."overall_band" * 2) = floor("ai_evaluations"."overall_band" * 2))

assessment_sets_scope_chk.name: assessment_sets_scope_chk
assessment_sets_scope_chk.value:
("assessment_sets"."assessment_type" = 'ACTIVE_DRILL'      AND "assessment_sets"."sub_module_id" IS NOT NULL AND "assessment_sets"."module_id" IS NULL AND "assessment_sets"."tier_id" IS NULL) OR
    ("assessment_sets"."assessment_type" = 'SKIP_MODULE_TEST'  AND "assessment_sets"."module_id"    IS NOT NULL AND "assessment_sets"."sub_module_id" IS NULL AND "assessment_sets"."tier_id" IS NULL) OR
    ("assessment_sets"."assessment_type" IN ('SKIP_TIER_TEST','TIER_BOSS_EXAM') AND "assessment_sets"."tier_id" IS NOT NULL AND "assessment_sets"."sub_module_id" IS NULL AND "assessment_sets"."module_id" IS NULL) OR
    ("assessment_sets"."assessment_type" = 'BOSS_SECTION'      AND "assessment_sets"."parent_set_id" IS NOT NULL) OR
    ("assessment_sets"."assessment_type" = 'PLACEMENT_TEST'    AND "assessment_sets"."sub_module_id" IS NULL AND "assessment_sets"."module_id" IS NULL)

attempts_band_chk.name: attempts_band_chk
attempts_band_chk.value: "attempts"."band_score" IS NULL OR ("attempts"."band_score" >= 0 AND "attempts"."band_score" <= 9 AND ("attempts"."band_score" * 2) = floor("attempts"."band_score" * 2))

band_rows_band_chk.name: band_rows_band_chk
band_rows_band_chk.value: "band_conversion_rows"."band" IS NULL OR ("band_conversion_rows"."band" >= 0 AND "band_conversion_rows"."band" <= 9 AND ("band_conversion_rows"."band" * 2) = floor("band_conversion_rows"."band" * 2))

content_assets_nocopy_chk.name: content_assets_nocopy_chk
content_assets_nocopy_chk.value: NOT ("content_assets"."rights_status" IN ('LINK_ONLY','EMBED_ONLY') AND "content_assets"."storage_key" IS NOT NULL)

content_assets_location_chk.name: content_assets_location_chk
content_assets_location_chk.value: ("content_assets"."storage_backend" = 'EXTERNAL' AND "content_assets"."external_url" IS NOT NULL) OR ("content_assets"."storage_backend" <> 'EXTERNAL' AND "content_assets"."storage_key" IS NOT NULL)

tiers_band_min_chk.name: tiers_band_min_chk

tiers_band_max_chk.name: tiers_band_max_chk

users_target_band_chk.name: users_target_band_chk
